details.title: Subcontractor Services Agreement

governing_law_source.quote: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. ... the courts at Pune, Maharashtra shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or relating to this Agreement.

details.parties_quote: by and between AtliQ Technologies Pvt Ltd, a private limited company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013, CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456, GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3, having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India ("AtliQ"), and Kriti Data Labs LLP, a limited liability partnership registered under the Limited Liability Partnership Act, 2008, having its office at Office No. 7, 2nd Floor, Shreeji Heights, Kothrud, Pune 411038, Maharashtra, India ("Vendor").

payment_source.quote: AtliQ shall pay each properly submitted, undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days after AtliQ receives the corresponding payment from the End Client, and in any event not later than one hundred and twenty (120) days after AtliQ's receipt of the invoice.

details.services_summary: Cleansing, labelling and annotation of machine-sensor time-series data and maintenance records for the End Client's predictive-maintenance models.

liability_cap.quote: ATLIQ'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES ACTUALLY PAID BY ATLIQ TO VENDOR UNDER THIS AGREEMENT.

delay_penalty.quote: If Vendor fails to achieve any Delivery Date, Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.

details.one_sided_note: The confidentiality obligations in Article 6 are primarily focused on the Vendor protecting AtliQ's information.

restrictive_covenants.summary: Vendor grants AtliQ a perpetual license to use annotation outputs.
restrictive_covenants.quote: Vendor grants AtliQ a non-exclusive, non-transferable, perpetual licence to use the annotation outputs and Deliverables for the purposes of the End Client project

findings.title: Delay penalty with no cap
findings.why: AtliQ could pay for delays it did not cause (Brightwater).
findings.comparison: Past contracts cap penalties at 5% of the milestone and exclude client delay (3 of 3).
findings.quote: If Vendor fails to achieve any Delivery Date, Vendor shall pay AtliQ, as liquidated damages, an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the Total Fees for each calendar day from the Delivery Date until the date the applicable Deliverable is accepted.

findings.title: Payment in 120 days
findings.why: Long payment terms hurt cash flow.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall pay each properly submitted, undisputed invoice within fifteen (15) days after AtliQ receives the corresponding payment from the End Client, and in any event not later than one hundred and twenty (120) days after AtliQ's receipt of the invoice.

findings.title: Parties and fee direction reversed
findings.why: It makes AtliQ pay Vendor instead of Kriti Data Labs paying AtliQ.
findings.comparison: Contradicts the context that AtliQ is owed the annual fee of INR 840,000.
findings.quote: AtliQ shall pay Vendor the Fees set forth in the Engagement Schedule.

findings.title: No payment for work in progress on termination
findings.why: If Kriti terminates for convenience, AtliQ is not paid for unaccepted work done.
findings.comparison: Violates the principle that AtliQ must be paid for work done on termination.
findings.quote: AtliQ's sole obligation shall be to pay Fees for Deliverables accepted... AtliQ shall have no obligation to pay for work in progress

findings.title: Vendor retains all IP in deliverables and tools
findings.why: Client usually expects to own the deliverables built for them, but this gives Vendor ownership of outputs.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles state the client owns what AtliQ builds. Here AtliQ appears to be the vendor/service provider.
findings.quote: Vendor shall retain all right, title and interest in and to its tools, labelling platform, scripts, ontologies, annotation guidelines developed by Vendor, and annotation outputs

findings.title: Indemnity covers AtliQ's own negligence
findings.why: Forces AtliQ to cover losses caused by the other party's own negligence.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles state AtliQ does not cover the other side's own negligence and indemnities should be mutual.
findings.quote: regardless of whether such Losses are caused in whole or in part by the negligence of any AtliQ Indemnitee

findings.title: Vendor liability is completely uncapped
findings.why: Exposes Vendor to unlimited direct and indirect liability with no ceiling.
findings.comparison: AtliQ principles prefer a 1x cap proportionate to contract value.
findings.quote: NOTHING IN THIS AGREEMENT SHALL LIMIT OR EXCLUDE VENDOR'S LIABILITY FOR ANY LOSSES, WHETHER DIRECT OR INDIRECT

findings.title: EU personal data but no DPA referenced
findings.why: A GDPR data processing agreement is usually needed.
findings.comparison: European work with personal data needs a DPA.

findings.title: Unlimited rejection and refund rights
findings.why: The clause allows for indefinite rejection cycles and full refunds without a clear cap or exit mechanism, creating significant revenue risk.
findings.comparison: Standard contracts typically include a defined number of iterations or a clear path to termination/payment for work performed.
findings.quote: AtliQ may repeat the acceptance process until the Deliverable conforms, or may, at its option, reject the Deliverable and receive a refund of all Fees paid in respect thereof.

findings.title: One-sided confidentiality obligations
findings.why: Only AtliQ's information is protected; Vendor has no matching confidentiality duties.
findings.comparison: Principles require confidentiality to be mutual.
findings.claimed_quote: "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by or on behalf of AtliQ... Vendor shall hold Confidential Information in strict confidence

findings.title: Liability cap applies only to AtliQ
findings.why: Liability cap is worded reciprocally or upside down as if AtliQ is paying the vendor.
findings.comparison: Standard is 1x fees; text references fees paid by AtliQ to vendor despite context.
findings.quote: ATLIQ'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED THE FEES ACTUALLY PAID BY ATLIQ TO VENDOR
